title: English A: Literature · Paper 2 — original comparative-essay sample
subject: english-a-literature
instructions: Choose one prompt and compare two literary works studied in class. Enter the complete essay in DigitalDP; no separate answer sheet is used.

questions.label: Prompt 1
questions.prompt: Compare how two studied works turn memory into a source of both comfort and conflict.

questions.label: Prompt 2
questions.prompt: Compare the effects of narrative or dramatic perspective in shaping sympathy in two studied works.

questions.label: Prompt 3
questions.prompt: Compare how images of home are complicated in two studied works.

questions.prompt: Compare how two studied works use moments of recognition to alter the audience’s understanding of a character.
